html:
Arriving in Da Lat after a flight, especially in the evening or early morning, can be tiring if you still need to look for transportation. With Da Lat airport pick up by private car, Vietlook Travel helps you start your trip smoothly, comfortably, and without any stress.

Instead of waiting for taxis or negotiating prices, your private car and driver will already be there, ready to take you directly to your hotel or accommodation in Da Lat City.

Smooth Transfer from Lien Khuong Airport to Da Lat City

Lien Khuong International Airport is located outside Da Lat City, and the road leading to the city center includes hills and mountain curves. Traveling by a private car with an experienced local driver ensures a safe and relaxing journey.

The distance from Lien Khuong Airport to Da Lat city center is around thirty kilometers, and the transfer usually takes about thirty five to forty five minutes, depending on traffic.

Private Airport Pick Up Designed for Your Comfort

This service is ideal for:

  • Couples, families, and small groups

  • Travelers with luggage or children

  • Visitors arriving late at night or early morning

  • Guests who value privacy and fixed pricing

You will be picked up directly at the airport and dropped off exactly where you need to go, without unnecessary stops or sharing the car with other passengers.

Meet and Greet at the Airport

Upon arrival at Lien Khuong International Airport, our driver will wait at the arrival area with a welcome sign showing your full name.

To arrange the service, please provide:

  • Flight number and landing time

  • Number of passengers

  • Hotel name or drop off address in Da Lat

The driver will assist with luggage and escort you to the car for a comfortable transfer.

Modern Vehicles and Professional Drivers

Vietlook Travel ensures:

  • Clean, modern, and well maintained vehicles

  • Strong air conditioning and seat belts in all seats

  • Polite and experienced drivers familiar with mountain roads

  • Free baby seat available upon request

Vehicle options include sedan cars, sport utility vehicles, minivans, and luxury cars.
